entries.title: Psalms 100:1
segments: <<A Psalm aof thanksgiving.>> Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah,  all ye lands.

entries.title: Psalms 100:2
segments: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.

entries.title: Psalms 100:3
segments: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us,  and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

entries.title: Psalms 100:4
segments: Enter into his gates with  thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.

entries.title: Psalms 100:5
segments: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
